name: smh_tile_rp3-rp3-COMMIT

structural_change: H-SM-REPACK (TILE-FILL 354b5bb2e: hfd_sm frames 362 mm2 at 19.5 % fill): the SM tile re-packed into a 388.8-um column.  (1) Leaves re-stacked N-S (xs | bdc+tct | tcl x2; leaf 1 MX about the channel), all 10 closed leaf views unchanged; (2) the cpt clock-rule FAIL (22,862 sinks, spine insertion 1,348 ps) removed structurally: the W transit and E beat stages are the CLOSED ot_smh_tr_group_beat_e master (2 instances, own roots), the tile root keeps ~14.6k sinks; (3) 267.84-um transport channel sized from the crossing bits (3,705 face pins on M4+M6 = 203 um; H cut 0.56); (4) no child gap under 20 um (min 21.6), every port registered at its pin by RTL. Same RTL cycles (GROUP_TRANSPORT / WEST_SPLIT are the exact-bench-proven group bodies).  Outline 388.8 x 1,183.68 = 0.460 mm2 (cpt 0.627, r16 0.790): SM frame 9.03 vs 11.32 mm2.
